entries.title: Isaiah 52:1
segments: Awake! Awake! Put on your strength, Zion; put on your beautiful robes, O Jerusalem, the holy city. For never again shall come to you uncircumcised and unclean ones.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:2
segments: Shake yourself from the dust; rise up! Sit, Jerusalem! Free yourself from your neckbands, O captive daughter of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:3
segments: For so says the LORD, You [were] sold for nothing; and you shall not be redeemed with silver.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:4
segments: For so says the Lord Jehovah, My people went down before [into] Egypt to stay there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:5
segments: Now therefore, what have I here, says the LORD, that My people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule [make them] howl, says the LORD; and without ceasing My name is blasphemed every day.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:6
segments: Therefore My people shall know My name; So [it shall be] in that day, for I [am] He who speaks; behold, [it is] I.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:7
segments: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good tidings, making peace heard; who brings good news, making salvation heard; who says to Zion, Your God reigns!

entries.title: Isaiah 52:8
segments: The voice of Your watchmen shall lift up! They lift up the voice together; they sing aloud. For they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:9
segments: Break out, sing together, waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:10
segments: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:11
segments: Turn! Turn! Go out from there! Touch not the unclean. Go out of her midst; purify yourself, bearers of the vessels of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:12
segments: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight; for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel gathers you.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:13
segments: Behold, My Servant shall rule well; He shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:14
segments: Just as many were astonished at You (so [much was] the disfigurement from man, His appearance and His form from the sons of mankind);

entries.title: Isaiah 52:15
segments: so He sprinkles from many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at Him; for they will see [that] which [was] not told to them; yea, what they had not heard, nor understood.
